title: Alderpoint: private hosting constraints & procurement timeline — recap and next steps
text:
Alderpoint: private hosting constraints & procurement timeline — recap and next steps

['From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@alderpoint.com>, Tom Nguyen <tomnguyen@alderpoint.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 13:17:00 -0500
Subject: Alderpoint: private hosting constraints & procurement timeline — recap and next steps

Hi Marta / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the key constraints, the goals you stated, and concrete next steps so we’re all aligned. I’ve kept this intentionally short.

Summary of pain points and goals
- Data residency: Alderpoint requires PHI and identified PII to remain in your EU/US-controlled tenancy for the initial launch (phase 1).
- Air-gap requirement: Some workflows (batch model training + model snapshots) must be handled in an air-gapped environment — no outbound egress allowed from those hosts.
- Network constraints: Production inference hosts must be able to initiate only to specific internal endpoints via private peering; outbound internet disallowed except via monitored proxy.
- KMS & key custody: You want customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) for encryption-at-rest and per-tenant key rotation tied to your KMS.
- Compliance pack: Security team needs SOC 2 evidence, data retention policies, and audit log access for the service accounts we’ll use.
- Timeline / procurement: Procurement indicated an expedited track: vendor review window ~4 weeks, legal review ~2 weeks, target procurement sign-off by mid-February to meet Q2 pilot.

Technical clarifications we agreed on
- Inference model: We can offer a private deployment (VPC) inside your AWS account or a customer-hosted on-prem bundle. For the air-gap workloads, we’ll support an isolated on-prem image with no external listeners.
- Egress model: For non-air-gapped inference, private peering + NAT through customer-managed egress gateway (we do not require public IPs on model hosts).
- Artifact exchange: We’ll use SFTP / signed artifact bundles for model binaries; metadata and telemetry can be forwarded to your logging endpoint.

Immediate next steps (mutual action plan)
1) Alderpoint → share: CIDR ranges for peering, a list of endpoints allowed for model telemetry, and your preferred KMS (by Fri 2028-01-20).
2) Redwood → share: initial MAP (attached: Alderpoint-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a short ask list for security (attached: redwood-onprem-asklist.pdf).
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra/security + our SEs (Aditya / Jonas) — propose 60 minutes next week; please provide 3 windows.
4) Redwood → prepare a draft SOW + POC plan (goal: 4-week POC following procurement sign-off).

Attachments: Alderpoint-MAP-v1.xlsx, redwood-onprem-asklist.pdf

If any of the bullets above are off, tell me and I’ll correct — otherwise we’ll treat this as the working MAP and move to schedule the deep-dive.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Subject: Re: Alderpoint: private hosting constraints & procurement timeline — recap and next steps

Thanks Kimberly — this is helpful and captures the bulk of it. Two clarifications from our side:
1) Air-gap scope: only the TRAINING pipeline and model snapshot exports must exist in the air-gapped environment. Runtime inference for clinical inference may live in a private VPC but must not make calls to third-party SaaS.
2) Timeline: Procurement will start vendor security review week of Jan 22 (not this coming week). Procurement contact (procurement@alderpoint.com) is copied — they’ll expect the security packet and a network diagram by Jan 21 to begin their check.

We’ll send the CIDR ranges and KMS owner by Monday. For the deep dive, Jan 18 or Jan 19 afternoons work for our infra team.

—Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Infrastructure | Alderpoint Health

- Air-gap scope: understood — we’ll propose an on-prem image for training + snapshot export that is fully isolated and supports only signed artifact export to your transfer node.
- Procurement timing: thanks for the correction. We’ll aim to have the baseline security packet + network sketch to procurement by EOD Jan 20 to meet your Jan 21 ask.

Proposed deep-dive windows (60 min):
- Tue Jan 18, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue Jan 18, 15:00–16:00 PT
- Wed Jan 19, 14:00–15:00 PT

Aditya / Jonas — can one of you take the tech lead on the deep-dive and confirm which of the slots works? I’ll send a calendar invite once we have confirmation from Alderpoint.

I’ll also upload the MAP to our shared drive and send the HubSpot deal link to procurement.

Best,
Kimberly
